summary.work_completed: Wrote 5 test suites (component + unit + E2E) for FR-UI-002 BrickPalette sidebar. Tests cover all 5 acceptance criteria from Issue #24: brick type display with previews, brick type selection, color picker selection, sidebar width constraint, and colorPalette utility correctness.
key_findings: BrickPalette.tsx is scaffolded but not yet fully implemented — tests are written against the LLD contract
uiStore.ts has activeBrickType and activeColor state — tests mock this store
colorPalette.ts utility exists and must export exactly 12 hex color strings
Sidebar must use w-64 (256px) Tailwind class to satisfy the 25% canvas constraint
R3F/Three.js must be mocked in jsdom environment for component tests

human_review_required.item: BrickPalette component implementation must add data-testid attributes
human_review_required.reason: Tests rely on data-testid='brick-palette', data-testid='brick-preview-{id}', data-testid='color-swatch-{hex}' — coding agent must add these

human_review_required.item: BrickPalette must use aria-pressed or aria-selected for active state
human_review_required.reason: Tests assert active brick type and active color swatch carry ARIA attributes for accessibility

human_review_required.item: Sidebar must use role='complementary' with aria-label='Brick Palette'
human_review_required.reason: E2E tests locate sidebar via getByRole('complementary', { name: /brick palette/i })

recommended_actions: Implement BrickPalette component at frontend/src/components/ui/BrickPalette.tsx per the LLD at docs/features/FR-UI-002/LOW_LEVEL_DESIGN.md
Add data-testid='brick-palette' to the sidebar root element
Add data-testid='brick-preview-{brickId}' to each brick type preview button
Add data-testid='color-swatch-{hexWithoutHash}' to each color swatch button
Use role='complementary' and aria-label='Brick Palette' on the sidebar root
Use aria-pressed='true/false' on active brick type and active color swatch
Apply Tailwind class w-64 (max-width: 256px) to the sidebar root
Wire brick type clicks to uiStore.setActiveBrickType(brickId)
Wire color swatch clicks to uiStore.setActiveColor(hexColor)
Ensure colorPalette utility exports exactly 12 hex color strings
